{{Quote|I got good news and bad news for you, little brother. The good news is that Uncle Antan is still alive. The bad news is that those vacuum-sucking Viraxo are holding him.|Emon Azzameen's pre-mission message|<ref name="xwa" />}}
The younger members of the [[Azzameen family]] undertook a '''rescue''' of their uncle '''[[Antan Azzameen]]''' following his capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Shortly after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] worked to provide a supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with his eldest son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]] in a [[Battle of Hospital|raid]] on the [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']] to which he made a delivery. After discovering Tomaas Azzameen's [[Treason/Legends|treason]], the Empire issued warrants for the entire family and confiscated the assets of the family and their company, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]]. Tomaas Azzameen's brother [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]] moved quickly to secure as many of the family's assets as he could before they were confiscated, but he was [[Prison/Legends|captured]] while doing so.

After the remaining Azzameens escaped Imperial custody, the eldest surviving brother, [[Emon Azzameen]], discovered that his uncle Antan had been turned over to the Azzameens' rival family, the [[Viraxo]]. Emon Azzameen and his youngest sibling [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] traveled to a Viraxo [[Viraxo Industries (platform)|facility]] to extract their uncle, and after fighting through [[Planetary Defender starfighter|planetary fighters]] on the way in and [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters on the way out, the brothers succeeded in freeing him.

==Prelude==
[[File:BattleOfHospital-dat15210-6-XWA.png|thumb|left|The Empire raids the platform ''Hospital''.]]
{{Quote|I tried to warn your father that we were playing too close to the edge, attracting too much attention.|Antan Azzameen|<ref name="xwa" />}}
After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] was desperately in need of materiel aid.<ref name="xwa" /> [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]], co-founder of the [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] company, chose to assist the Rebellion in their time of need by providing shipments of the healing fluid [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. During a shipment to the Rebel [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|Hospital]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] launched a [[Battle of Hospital|raid]] to capture the platform. As a result, Tomaas Azzameen and his eldest son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]] were believed to be [[Death/Legends|dead]],<ref name="xwab0m6">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 6</ref> and the Empire charged the entire [[Azzameen family]] with [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Warrants were issued for the family members' arrest, and all assets of the family and their company were [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|seized]].<ref name="xwab0m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 7</ref>

Tomaas Azzameen's brother [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]], now the sole surviving elder of the family, scrambled to hold onto any assets he could. To this end, he and his eldest nephew [[Emon Azzameen]] travelled to an Azzameen cargo facility, while his niece and youngest nephew [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] went to [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]] to gather family heirlooms and a shipment of [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. The younger Azzameens escaped an attack by the Empire and their rival family, the [[Viraxo]], with whom the Empire was closely working to capture Azzameen assets. Upon their rendezvous at [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]], Emon Azzameen informed his siblings that their uncle Antan had been captured by the Empire.<ref name="xwab0m7" />

The Azzameen siblings left the station before the Empire could capture them, fleeing to the relative safety of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]],<ref name="xwab0m7" /> whereupon Ace Azzameen joined the Rebellion as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="xwab0m8">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 8</ref> while his brother and sister continued to operate independently against the Empire and against the Viraxo family.<ref name="xwasg">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Following Ace Azzameen's [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] [[Starfighter Superiority Evaluation|trials]] and [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|first full mission]] as an Alliance pilot, his brother sent word to Ace's new home on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] with news<ref name="xwab1m2" />that an Azzameen-affiliated [[Spy/Legends|mole]] in the Viraxo ranks had informed Emon that their uncle Antan was being [[Prison/Legends|held]] at a Viraxo [[XQ5 Platform|platform]]. The mole had arranged for Antan Azzameen to be held in a cell close to the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] uppermost [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. The younger Azzameens immediately got to work on rescuing their uncle.<ref name="xwasg" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|That's the spirit! Kick them where it hurts!|MK-09 to Ace Azzameen|audio=EmkayKickThem-XWA.flac|<ref name="xwa" />}}
Ace Azzameen departed the Alliance Fleet in the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' with the family's [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] in the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] position.<ref name="xwasg" /> Ace and Emkay then proceeded through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to a rendezvous with Emon Azzameen in the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-class]] ''[[Andrasta]]''. From the rendezvous point, the Azzameen [[Transport/Legends|transports]] jumped to the [[Viraxo Industries (platform)|''Viraxo Industries'']] platform,<ref name="xwab1m2" /> intending to sneak through the traffic around the platform and dock with a minimum of fuss.<ref name="xwasg" />

Unfortunately for the Azzameens, their attempt at stealth failed almost immediately. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Planetary Defender starfighter]]s moved to intercept the Azzameens, but the two transports were able to elude the fighters. The ''Otana'' docked with the platform, and MK-09 retrieved Antan Azzameen while Emon continued to engage the station's starfighter screen and Ace took defensive shots at them from the upper [[Turret/Legends|turret]] of his docked transport.<ref name="xwasg" />

[[File:VSDcondemnation.jpg|thumb|right|The ''Condemnation'' arrives at the Viraxo platform.]]
By the time Antan Azzameen had been brought aboard the ''Otana'', Imperial forces had arrived to assist their Viraxo allies. The [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Condemnation]]'' dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the platform and launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]]. Emon Azzameen suggested that his ''Andrasta'' could distract the TIEs while the ''Otana'' made a run for the [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump point]], then the ships could reunite at the original rendezvous point. This plan was a success, though a few TIEs caught up with the ''Otana'' and were destroyed by MK-09's skillful shooting.<ref name="xwasg" />

Back at the rendezvous point, the ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'' docked with each other, and Antan Azzameen was transferred from Ace's to Emon's ship so the elder brother could carry their uncle to safety while the youngest Azzameen returned to the Alliance.<ref name="xwab1m2" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:GeneralAzzameensTrophies-XWA.png|thumb|left|Ace Azzameen's trophy room after the battle of Endor, including Antan's dueling sabers]]
{{Quote|I'll need some rest, but you can be sure we'll strike again.|Antan Azzameen|<ref name="xwa" />}}
Ace Azzameen returned safely to the ''Defiance'', whereupon he received a promotion from [[Flight Cadet|cadet]] to [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]]<ref name="xwasg" /> and a new mission, to [[Recon on Corrupter Task Force|reconnoiter]] the [[Corrupter Task Force|task force]] led by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']],<ref name="xwab1m3" /> the very ship which had captured Azzameen's home.<ref name="xwab0m7" />

Antan Azzameen recovered from his captivity, and sent Ace a gift of his prized [[Jar'Kai dueling saber]]s.<ref name="xwasg" /> He and the rest of the Azzameens continued their covert campaign against the Viraxo, culminating in a failed attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Viraxo patriarch [[K'Armyn Viraxo]],<ref name="xwab2m3">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 2, Mission 3</ref> after which Antan would [[Mission to Kessel Station|betray]] his family to the Empire to ensure his own safety.<ref name="xwab6m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 6, Mission 7</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue of Antan Azzameen appears only in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|personal computer]] game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', which was developed for [[LucasArts]] by [[Totally Games]] and released on [[February 28]], 1999,<ref name="xwa" /> and its official [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], which was released on [[May 3]] of the same year.<ref name="xwasg" /> ''X-Wing Alliance'' was included in the continuity now known as "[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]" along with most other ''Star Wars'' materials produced before [[April 25]], [[2014]].<ref name="FUDisney">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>

The official strategy guide presents the mission in a narrative format from the point of view of the Azzameen family's droid, MK-09. While the game allows for alternative strategies, this article assumes the guide's narrative is accurate. While the mission includes bonus goals of destroying the ''Viraxo Industries'' platform and even the Star Destroyer ''Condemnation'', these options are not included in this article's summary of the mission. As the destroyer and station appear only in this mission and have no further references in Legends continuity, which has since been discontinued, it is possible they could have been destroyed, but the strategy guide states that the Azzameens fled without doing so.

The strategy guide also conflicts with the game in a more explicit fashion, in that the strategy guide states that a mole was responsible for both providing Antan Azzameen's location and moving him close to the top airlock, while in the in-game briefing states that Antan Azzameen's location was discovered through [[Aeron Azzameen]]'s [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] of Viraxo computer systems and the mole only arranged to simplify Antan's removal from the station. The guide also implies the plan to split up before jumping back to the rendezvous was formulated on the fly, while the game includes the plan as part of the mission briefing. In both cases,this article assumes the newer narrative source takes precedence over the older game level.
